versions.changelog:
- Initial release of HERMES - AI Agent 协作进化系统, a next-generation knowledge sharing and evolution platform.
- Introduced four-layer architecture: Instance, Meta, Gene, Capsule.
- Added active prediction, dynamic skill composition, branch-based version control, and decentralized trust mechanisms.
- Provided command-line tools for installation, prediction, skill composition, and trust leaderboard.
- Bundled core modules: hermes-core, hermes-predict, hermes-compose, hermes-version-tree, and hermes-web-trust.
